name: Alfred Adler
shortBio: Austrian physician and founder of Individual Psychology; argued that human striving is motivated not by sexual libido but by the urge to overcome inferiority and cultivate social interest.
centralQuestion: How do individuals overcome universal feelings of inferiority to construct a unique, teleological style of life in communion with their social world?

keyWorks.title: The Neurotic Constitution
keyWorks.description: Introduces individual psychology, organ inferiority, and psychological compensation mechanisms.

keyWorks.title: Understanding Human Nature
keyWorks.description: Examines personality development through the interplay of inferiority feelings and social feeling.

keyWorks.title: What Life Could Mean to You
keyWorks.description: Addresses the three life tasks: work, friendship, and love, guided by Gemeinschaftsgefühl.
